chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh and Faḍālah, from Abān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبَانٍ: Abān, a narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurārah, a major transmitter from the Imam
key_terms.عَنْهُ: from him; an abbreviated link in the sanad referring to a previously mentioned transmitter
key_terms.فَضَالَةَ: Faḍālah, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the like of it; indicating the matn is the same as the previous report

ai.seo_question: What does a hadith stating "the like of it" mean in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This report transmits the same ruling as the preceding narration through a different sanad. It belongs to the legal discussions on prescribed punishments related to theft and related offenses, reinforcing the ruling by corroboration.
